title: Airport security screening trays
lede: Heavy-duty passenger screening trays for airport checkpoint conveyors — stackable, impact-resistant and custom-branded to the operator’s livery (shown here in Abu Dhabi Airports Company / ADAC colours). Sized to fit standard X-ray tunnels and return-belt systems.
bullets: Nestable / stackable to save belt-side space
Sized for standard X-ray tunnel & return-belt systems
Smooth radius corners — easy cleaning, no snag points

title: “Follow Me” LED guidance boards
lede: Roof-mounted programmable LED “FOLLOW ME” boards for airport marshalling and apron-guidance vehicles. High-brightness amber matrix readable in direct sunlight, paired with rotating beacons for airside visibility during aircraft and vehicle escort.
bullets: High-brightness amber LED matrix — sunlight readable
Roof-bar mount with twin rotating beacons
Wide operating-temperature range for apron use
